items.question: Customers expressed dissatisfaction with the cost of the phone, but complaints about the user interface were relatively -------.
items.answer_explain: were 后需要说明 complaints 特征的表语，relatively 是修饰程度的副词，因此用形容词 rare，选 B。A rarest 是最高级，句中没有最高级的比较范围，relatively rare 才是自然搭配；C rarity 是名词；D rarely 是副词，不能在这里作形容词表语。
items.question_translation: 顾客对这款手机的价格表示不满，但针对用户界面的投诉相对**少见**。
items.grammar_point: be + 形容词作表语；relatively 修饰形容词原级 rare
